description: A React component for a dialog that allows adding or editing text annotations on a Plotly chart, including styling options and annotation management.

methods.name: TextChartDialog
methods.description: Main React component function for the text annotation dialog, managing state, effects, and rendering UI.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input changes, updating form data state.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Validates and submits the annotation data, adding or updating annotations.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current annotation if in edit mode.
